first_run.label: Welcome to MathTrail
first_run.lead: MathTrail gives a child olympiad-style maths tasks for grades 1 to 6, right here in the chat, and goes through every mistake. An adult sets it up: a parent or a tutor.
first_run.pseudonym: The child is known by a pseudonym alone: never a real name, a birth date or a school.
first_run.fill: A pseudonym and the grade, 1 to 6. If you like, also the child's interests, what they have not met at school yet, and the language of the lessons.
first_run.data: In one file in your own Google Drive, which you can open, download or delete. MathTrail keeps nothing on its side.
first_run.start: Ask in this chat for a MathTrail profile, and answer what it asks. You can change it later, under Profile & progress.
card.unreadable: This card can't be shown here. The chat says the same in words.
